_comment: Findings of migrations applied before the 0.8.0 check (R08-08). Each entry suppresses one rule for one revision; an entry that matches no finding fails the check. Add entries only for migrations that are already applied everywhere (when a rule or a large table is added to the check); a new migration uses an override marker with a reason in its own file (docs/CONTRIBUTING.md, Database migrations).

entries.reason: Applied before the 0.8.0 migration safety check; the index was built while the table was small and exists in every environment. New indexes on large tables use CONCURRENTLY in an autocommit block (20261128_0003 pattern).
